   I can only alize a iratte cortice atop another iratte if the iratte onto which I am alizing the iratte is concepillent.
   Once I rhodice or alize a iratte, my prousnes becomes bazatisesish.
   Once you alize a iratte cortice atop a second iratte, the second iratte is no longer concepillent.
